description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan product creation and updates with down payment configurations in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup routines, test cases for creating loan products with enabled down payments, updating existing loan products, and validation error scenarios related to down payment configuration parameters.

classes.name: LoanProductWithDownPaymentConfigurationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating loan product creation and update functionalities involving down payment configurations in the Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured configuration, request and response specifications, and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: loanProductCreationWithDownPaymentConfigurationTest
methods.description: Tests creation of a loan product with down payment enabled and verifies the configuration is saved correctly.

methods.name: loanProductUpdateWithEnableDownPaymentConfigurationTest
methods.description: Tests updating an existing loan product to enable down payment and verifies the update.

methods.name: loanProductEnableDownPaymentConfigurationValidationTests
methods.description: Validates various error scenarios when setting invalid down payment configurations on loan products.

methods.name: updateLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to modify an existing loan product to enable down payment with specific settings.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with default settings.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithDownPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specific down payment configuration parameters.
